editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: LiteFinance is a legitimate broker scoring 6.2/10 from NAFT in 2026. Operating since 2005 (formerly LiteForex), it offers CySEC regulation for EU/EEA clients and a strong social trading platform that genuinely differentiates it in the copy-trading space. The $10 minimum deposit, MT4/MT5/cTrader platform suite, and fast withdrawal reports make it accessible and functional. But the dual-entity model is the defining concern: most international clients trade under an SVG/Marshall Islands shell with zero regulatory oversight, no compensation scheme, and no meaningful complaint escalation path. Twenty years without a major scandal is reassuring — but it does not replace the protections that proper regulation provides.
